# `kernel/fs/isofs/cd9660` — the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — isofs/cd9660

## English

This directory contains the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — isofs/cd9660.

`config.mk` records 7 source file(s) here: `cd9660_bmap.c`, `cd9660_lookup.c`, `cd9660_node.c`, `cd9660_rrip.c`, `cd9660_util.c`, `cd9660_vfsops.c`, `cd9660_vnops.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
